mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.region_id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, a.accommodation_type, a.description, a.check_in_time, a.check_out_time, m.rating, m.thumbnail_url, m.price FROM merchants m JOIN accommodations a ON a.merchant_id = m.id WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} AND m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION'

SELECT rp.id AS product_id, rp.product_name, rp.description, rp.product_detail_type, rp.max_headcount, rp.unit_price, rp.thumbnail_url FROM reservation_products rp WHERE rp.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND rp.product_detail_type = 'ROOM' ORDER BY rp.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r WHERE r.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT rp.id AS product_id, rp.product_name, rp.description, rp.product_detail_type, rp.max_headcount, rp.unit_price, rp.thumbnail_url FROM reservation_products rp INNER JOIN offices o ON o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} WHERE rp.merchant_id = o.merchant_id AND rp.product_detail_type IN ('OFFICE_SEAT', 'MEETING_ROOM', 'PRIVATE_OFFICE') ORDER BY rp.id ASC

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.rating, COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) AS review_count, o.description, 0 AS bookmarked FROM merchants m INNER JOIN offices o ON o.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.merchant_id = m.id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} AND m.category = 'OFFICE' GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.rating, o.description

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.region_id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, m.rating, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) AS review_count, 0 AS bookmarked FROM merchants m INNER JOIN restaurants r2 ON r2.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.merchant_id = m.id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} AND m.category = 'RESTAURANT' GROUP BY m.id, m.region_id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, m.rating, m.thumbnail_url, m.price

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.region_id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, m.rating, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) AS review_count, 0 AS bookmarked FROM merchants m INNER JOIN activities a ON a.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.merchant_id = m.id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} AND m.category = 'ACTIVITY' GROUP BY m.id, m.region_id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, m.rating, m.thumbnail_url, m.price
